ideas.title: The Minnesota Medicaid Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program and the implications of the federal government's freeze on funding.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud and who is responsible
questions: Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
What is the extent of the fraud?
How will the freeze on funding affect Minnesota's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program and the implications of the federal government's freeze on funding. It would follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
